replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Honestly, yes. The abstract nature of math can trigger anxiety for me. I worry about making mistakes or not understanding complex concepts quickly. However, my high conscientiousness helps me push through that fear and focus on learning step by step.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I have used AI tools recently for quick explanations of difficult topics.
